articles.summary: Post hoc analyses of SION-719 PreciSION CF subset showed a mean placebo-adjusted sweat chloride reduction of up to -8.6 mmol/L consistent with NBD1 biological activity Dual combination Phase 2a trial expected to initiate in first quarter of 2027 46% workforce reduction and other cost-saving
articles.title: Sionna Therapeutics Announces Plans to Advance SION-451 + SION-2222 Dual Combination into Phase 2a Proof-of-Concept Trial
